notes: Recorded for the doctorate: 22 rows - 19 Schools or Colleges with an award (the same list as the first pass, which gives the awards, tenure and closing date of each) and 3 named GeoSciences PhD programmes.

No official page names the PhD programmes covered for the other Schools: the scheme text says the award is for 'a first year of full-time or part-time on campus or distance PhD study' at the University, and each School runs its own selection. The School is therefore the unit recorded; any PhD programme within a participating School is covered. The College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine row stands for the 6 awards of that College (its Schools are not itemised on the scheme page).

The School of Chemistry page says applicants must make the PhD programme application by 14 December 2026 to be eligible for the EDCS; the first pass stored a closing date of 11 January 2027 for Chemistry. Editors should check which applies. The Business School page says the availability of its award for 2027/28 is under review, and the scheme page says funding for 2027/28 is still being confirmed.
The Schools' older pages on the registry site (Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics and others) still show earlier years' text and tables and were not used for the 2027-28 list.
